# With New Leadership and Strategy, Kearny Bank Enhances Treasury Management Services for Business Clients


3/25/2026 3:55:39 PM


[Copy Link](https://x.com/intent/tweet?text=With%20New%20Leadership%20and%20Strategy,%20Kearny%20Bank%20Enhances%20Treasury%20Management%20Services%20for%20Business%20Clients&url=https://www.kearnybank.com/news/2026/march/with-new-leadership-and-strategy--kearny-bank-enhancestreasury-management-services-for-business-clients)[Link to Linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle?mini=true&url=https://www.kearnybank.com/news/2026/march/with-new-leadership-and-strategy--kearny-bank-enhancestreasury-management-services-for-business-clients&title=With%20New%20Leadership%20and%20Strategy,%20Kearny%20Bank%20Enhances%20Treasury%20Management%20Services%20for%20Business%20Clients&)[Link to X (formerly Twitter)](https://x.com/intent/tweet?text=With%20New%20Leadership%20and%20Strategy,%20Kearny%20Bank%20Enhances%20Treasury%20Management%20Services%20for%20Business%20Clients&url=https://www.kearnybank.com/news/2026/march/with-new-leadership-and-strategy--kearny-bank-enhancestreasury-management-services-for-business-clients)[Link to Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https://www.kearnybank.com/news/2026/march/with-new-leadership-and-strategy--kearny-bank-enhancestreasury-management-services-for-business-clients)


**FAIRFIELD, NJ** – Highlighting enhancement of its Treasury Management program, Kearny Bank has appointed Pine Brook resident Telizabeth Lopez to support commercial clients in identifying related services that address their particular needs.


Specifically, Lopez – whose title is Assistant Vice President/Treasury Management Lead – serves as a centralized resource for all Kearny Bank employees. She partners with retail relationship managers and commercial loan officers in a consultative approach that supports business clients in optimizing cash flow and liquidity. From access to expanded international wire services to solutions that include escrow management and merchant services, the bank has streamlined the transaction process.


Lopez has a professional background in Treasury Management sales and holds a bachelor’s degree in business administration, with a management minor, from Caldwell University.


“For Kearny Bank, enhancing our Treasury Management services is a strategic priority,” says Heather Moskal, Senior Vice President/Director of Retail and Commercial Deposits. “Telizabeth serves as a bank-wide resource, with her expertise providing our clients with more tailored guidance, faster problem-solving, and a clearer path to improved cash flow.”


To ensure business clients receive the most effective consultation about options and opportunities, Kearny Bank is elevating instruction of its team members across all sectors. In addition, the bank continually assesses the latest Treasury Management products and services so its commercial clients have access to the best available solutions.


**About Kearny Bank**


Combining the finest traditions of community banking with the industry’s latest, most effective financial products and services, Kearny Bank provides business and personal clients with the tools for success. Established back in 1884, and now operating from corporate offices in Fairfield, NJ, Kearny Bank’s footprint covers most of New Jersey, along with Brooklyn and Staten Island.
